**Step 1 — Scene:** Rice topped with chicken pieces and a glossy brown sauce. The separate side salad and drinks are excluded.

**Step 2 — Vessel:** Main disposable dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across. Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

**Step 3 — Items:** Cooked white rice, cooked chicken pieces, and brown sauce. Any visible cooking fat is included in the chicken/sauce estimates rather than counted separately.

**Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Area shares partition the food-covered footprint to avoid counting overlapping areas twice.

|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| Chicken pieces | 17% | 90 cm² × 1.2 cm | 108 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 103 g | 200 | 206 kcal |
| Brown sauce | 3% | 16 cm² × 0.8 cm | 13 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 13 g | 130 | 17 kcal |

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** The food occupies approximately **48% of the plate**, with some height from the piled rice and chicken. An estimated **330 g and 501 kcal** is plausible for the visible portion. The main uncertainties are pile depth and the amount of fat in the sauce.
